name: Workspace Card Consistency and Navigation Stability Hotfix
root_cause: The module-experience stylesheet was guarded by persistent Streamlit session state. Multipage navigation replaced the DOM but retained the guard, so later pages skipped CSS injection and rendered workspace cards as concatenated text.
fixes: Inject the shared workspace stylesheet on every page render
Add resilient display rules for shells, headers, badges, card grids, cards and text blocks
Add stable workspace summary diagnostic markers
Keep all 77 affected pages on one shared renderer
